label: ZTE MC801A 5G indoor CPE
description: ZTE 5G indoor CPE (Snapdragon X55, sub-6 NSA/SA with LTE Cat 22 fallback) quoting 4.6 Gbps peak 5G downlink and 3.8 Gbps in EN-DC. Two Gigabit RJ45 LAN ports, one of which can be switched to WAN mode, plus dual-band Wi-Fi 6; the 5G uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
